scenarios.title: A｜询问替代航班
scenarios.setting: 在“航班取消”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问替代航班”。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but flight AB126 has been cancelled.

turns.prompt: 你想查询当天还可以选择的替代航班，会怎么说？

choices.text: Are there any other flights to London today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any other flights to London today?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: What’s the next available flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the next available flight?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Is there another flight I can take instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another flight I can take instead?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: What options do I have now?

feedback.naturalExpression: What options do I have now?
feedback.explanation: “what options”询问可选方案，便于在了解条件后作决定。

choices.text: Do you have another airplane for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any other flights to London today?
feedback.explanation: 这里要找的是另一个“flight”即航班，不是另一架“airplane”；明确班次才便于改签。

turns.text: There’s another flight at 9:40 tonight, but seats are limited.

turns.prompt: 你想确认替代航班是否有位、能否改签过去，会怎么说？

choices.text: Are there still seats available on that flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there still seats available on that flight?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Could I be moved to that flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I be moved to that flight?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Is there anything earlier with another airline?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything earlier with another airline?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What about tomorrow morning?

feedback.naturalExpression: What about tomorrow morning?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

turns.text: There are a few seats left on tonight’s flight.

turns.prompt: 关于「航班取消」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to take that one if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to take that one if possible.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could you reserve a seat for me on that flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you reserve a seat for me on that flight?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Yes, please move me to the 9:40 flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please move me to the 9:40 flight.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

scenarios.title: B｜申请改签
scenarios.setting: 在“航班取消”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“申请改签”。

turns.prompt: 关于「航班取消」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to be rebooked on the next available flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to be rebooked on the next available flight.
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Could you rebook me for tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you rebook me for tonight?
feedback.explanation: “rebook”指重新预订或改订，重点是安排新的班次或时间。

choices.text: Can you move my booking to another flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you move my booking to another flight?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I’d like to change to the earliest available flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change to the earliest available flight.
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Can you change me another flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to be rebooked on the next available flight.
feedback.explanation: 改到另一航班可说“rebook me on another flight”或“change me to …”，不能省去连接词。

turns.text: I can put you on the 9:40 flight tonight or the 8:15 flight tomorrow morning.

turns.prompt: 你想比较两个改签方案的时间或费用条件，会怎么说？

choices.text: Which flight is more likely to leave on time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which flight is more likely to leave on time?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Are both options free of charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are both options free of charge?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Would my checked baggage be transferred automatically?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would my checked baggage be transferred automatically?
feedback.explanation: “baggage”指行李的统称，航空运输中经常使用。

choices.text: Could I take tomorrow morning’s flight instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I take tomorrow morning’s flight instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

turns.text: There will be no change fee because your original flight was cancelled.

turns.prompt: 关于「航班取消」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: In that case, I’d like the morning flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, I’d like the morning flight.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: Great. Please rebook me for tomorrow morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Please rebook me for tomorrow morning.
feedback.explanation: “rebook”指重新预订或改订，重点是安排新的班次或时间。

choices.text: Will I receive a new boarding pass?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I receive a new boarding pass?
feedback.explanation: “boarding pass”指登机牌，区别于预订记录或付款凭证。

choices.text: Do I need to check in again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to check in again?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

turns.text: I’ll issue a new boarding pass for you now.

scenarios.title: C｜询问住宿 / 补偿安排
scenarios.setting: 在“航班取消”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问住宿 / 补偿安排”。

turns.prompt: 你想询问隔夜延误是否提供住宿安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Since the next flight isn’t until tomorrow, is any accommodation being provided?

feedback.naturalExpression: Since the next flight isn’t until tomorrow, is any accommodation being provided?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Does the airline provide a hotel for overnight delays?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does the airline provide a hotel for overnight delays?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Is there any assistance available for passengers who need to stay overnight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any assistance available for passengers who need to stay overnight?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: What arrangements are being made for tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: What arrangements are being made for tonight?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Will you pay my hotel tonight?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Since the next flight isn’t until tomorrow, is any accommodation being provided?
feedback.explanation: 住宿费用应说“pay for my hotel”；若在询问延误保障，问是否“cover the hotel cost”更准确。

turns.text: We’re providing hotel accommodation and meal vouchers for eligible passengers.

turns.prompt: 你想了解怎样领取酒店住宿凭证，会怎么说？

choices.text: How do I get the hotel voucher?

feedback.naturalExpression: How do I get the hotel voucher?
feedback.explanation: “how do I get”询问到达方法，方便对方提供路线或交通方式。

choices.text: Is transportation to the hotel included?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is transportation to the hotel included?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Where do I collect the meal voucher?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where do I collect the meal voucher?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的信息限定为地点或位置，适合请人指路或定位物品。

choices.text: Do I need to book the hotel myself?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to book the hotel myself?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

turns.text: We’ll arrange the hotel for you. A shuttle will leave from outside Terminal B.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: What time does the shuttle leave?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time does the shuttle leave?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Do I need to collect my checked luggage tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to collect my checked luggage tonight?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Where should I come back tomorrow morning?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where should I come back tomorrow morning?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Will my new flight information be sent to me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will my new flight information be sent to me?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

turns.text: Your new booking will be sent by email and text message.
